subject: Conditional verification: extended log retention & backup purge waiver request
messages:
From: Julia Sutherland <j.sutherland@mediroot.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: MediRoot Legal <legal@mediroot.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary log retention extension + backup purge offset

Markus —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. MediRoot has a compliance window for an upcoming regulator-led review (notified 2027-08-05) and we need two temporary accommodations from Redwood while the audit is underway:

1) A 90-day conditional exception to extend application/system log retention (including API access logs and request traces) beyond the default 30-day TTL for the MediRoot tenancy. This is strictly for the audit window and must be revocable.

2) Delay of scheduled backup purges for any backups containing MediRoot data by 60 days from their normal purge date so we can complete evidence collection.

We understand this is outside standard policy; can you confirm who in Redwood can approve both items and what minimal evidence you need to accept this operational exception? We also need to capture a short audit trail (who authorized, timestamps, and rollback trigger).

Attaching our reg notice and a short questionnaire. Happy to jump on a call.

Julia
Julia Sutherland
Head of Security & Compliance, MediRoot
j.sutherland@mediroot.com
+1 415-555-0112

Attachments: mediroot-retention-ask-20270730.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Sutherland <j.sutherland@mediroot.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention extension + backup purge offset

Julia —

Thanks for the heads-up and the doc. We can support a temporary accommodation, but I want to align on scope and gating controls before any approve/commit:

- Scope: confirm the exact dataset(s) (product + environment) impacted — prod tenant vs. sandbox; do you need control-plane logs or only application-level telemetry?
- Timebox: you asked for 90 days for logs and 60 days for backups; we can propose 60 days log extension + 45 days backup delay as a conservative first pass while legal/ops finalize DPA redline.
- Authorization: Redwood requires written approval from Legal + Ops lead; I will loop Kimberly (Legal) and Karthik (Platform Ops) to scope technical feasibility and required safeguards (read-only access, encryption keys, access logs).
- Evidence: we need a regulator notice, point of contact, and a statement of purpose for the data retention extension.

Can you confirm the datasets and whether MediRoot will sign a short one-off Addendum? If yes, Kimberly can draft an expedited DPA addendum.

I propose a quick call tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize scope.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Reliability & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: Julia Sutherland <j.sutherland@mediroot.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: MediRoot Legal <legal@mediroot.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 07:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention extension + backup purge offset

Thanks Markus —

Scope: production tenancy only (prod.mediroot). We only need application/API request logs and authentication traces; control-plane metadata (provider billing, infra metrics) is out of scope.

We can accept the conservative approach you suggested (60 days for logs, 45 days for backup purges). MediRoot will sign a one-off addendum. Attached is the regulator notice and the filled questionnaire that lists the exact buckets and indices we want preserved.

Please confirm the call time works for your team; otherwise we can provide the requested attachments and signed statement via DocuSign.

Julia

Attachments: mediroot-retention-ask-20270730.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention extension + backup purge offset

Team —

Kevin (Legal) here — quick notes and proposed guardrails: (cc: Laura for ops)

1) Legal: I will prepare a narrow DPA Addendum draft that:
   - Limits retention to the specified indices in the attached questionnaire.
   - Requires MediRoot to accept (a) read-only access for Redwood auditors during the exception period, and (b) notification triggers if an access request is made.
   - Includes a rollback clause: Redwood can revert to standard retention immediately if we detect anomalous exfiltration or if the regulator request is withdrawn.

2) Ops: Karthik — can you confirm technical feasibility for:
   - Creating a one-off retention policy with a unique namespace and TTL override for prod.mediroot?
   - Delaying purge jobs and tagging backups that must be held?
   - Generating an immutable authorization record (who approved, timestamp, signed addendum link) that we store in the compliance ledger?

3) Evidence: MediRoot must supply official regulator notice (PDF) and the authorized signatory (DocuSign).

If ops confirms, I can send the DPA addendum to Mediroot via DocuSign today; proposed effective window: 2027-08-03 -> 2027-10-01 (60 days logs, 45 days backup hold).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Sutherland <j.sutherland@mediroot.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, MediRoot Legal <legal@mediroot.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention extension + backup purge offset — approval and next steps

Julia / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Ops confirmed feasibility and Kimberly has prepared a narrow addendum. Summary of agreed items: 

- Scope: prod.mediroot only; application/API request logs + auth traces.
- Window: effective 2027-08-03 00:00 UTC through 2027-10-01 23:59 UTC (60 days log retention extension; backup purge offset 45 days).
- Controls: read-only access for Redwood compliance, immutable authorization record stored in our compliance ledger, immediate rollback trigger on suspected exfiltration.
- Evidence required: signed DocuSign addendum + regulator notice (both attached to the case).

Action items: 
- Kimberly: send DocuSign addendum to MediRoot now (link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABCDEF-98765).
- Karthik / Laura: implement the TTL override and tag backups by 2027-08-03 02:00 UTC; generate audit entries for every access.
- Markus: capture final authorization in the account ledger and notify support/drift monitoring teams.

Julia — once you sign the addendum and upload the regulator notice we will flip the retention overrides and pause the purge jobs for tagged backups. We will confirm completion with a final email and include the compliance ledger entry id.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Reliability & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
